blocks.text: (a) Fire Department. All promotions of Fire Department personnel covered by this chapter shall be in accordance with Charter Ordinance No. 10 (Appx. A , Section A6-16 et seq.). (Ord. 20206 § 28, 9-10-19; Ord. 19370 § 84, 3-23-10. Code 1995 § 106-74. Formerly 2.125.200.)
